name: interop_regulon_clinvar
description: Cross-NIH interoperability: per-factor regulon gene sets intersected with ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely-pathogenic disease genes (ENCODE x ClinVar)

inputs.name: regulon_dir
inputs.description: Directory of per-factor regulon set subdirectories. Each subdir must contain geneset.tsv (header: gene) and optionally geneset.meta.json with 'target' field. Recommended input: output of encode_regulon_contrast (_specific_Up sets) to use background-corrected binding specificity. Raw regulon output also accepted.

inputs.name: regulon_zip
inputs.description: Zip archive of per-factor regulon set subdirectories. Alternative to regulon_dir.

inputs.name: clinvar_genes_tsv
inputs.description: Pre-computed ClinVar pathogenic gene set TSV (header: gene), e.g. from ClinVar_pathogenic_genes_all/geneset.tsv. Provides reproducibility without re-downloading variant_summary. If neither this nor variant_summary_gz is provided, variant_summary.txt.gz is auto-downloaded from https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/clinvar/tab_delimited/variant_summary.txt.gz.

inputs.name: variant_summary_gz
inputs.description: ClinVar variant_summary.txt.gz (NCBI FTP). Used to derive pathogenic gene sets on-the-fly (GRCh38; Pathogenic/Likely-pathogenic; single-gene variants). Auto-downloaded from https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/clinvar/tab_delimited/variant_summary.txt.gz if not provided and clinvar_genes_tsv is also absent.

parameters.name: assay
parameters.help: Assay label for set names and provenance (e.g. 'TF ChIP-seq', 'eCLIP'). Default 'TF ChIP-seq'.

parameters.name: lib_prefix
parameters.help: Prefix for output set names. Defaults to 'ENCODE_<safe_assay>_x_ClinVar'.

parameters.name: min_genes
parameters.help: Minimum intersection size to emit a set (default: 1). Increase to filter out near-empty sets.

outputs.name: <lib_prefix>_<target>_disease_targets/genesets.gmt
outputs.description: ClinVar pathogenic genes targeted by this factor

outputs.name: <lib_prefix>_any_factor_disease_targets/genesets.gmt
outputs.description: Union: ClinVar pathogenic genes targeted by at least one factor

outputs.name: <lib_prefix>_any_factor_disease_targets/geneset.meta.json
outputs.description: Metadata and provenance JSON for union set
